desktop.notes:
• HEIC / HEIF photos show their picture (they said "No preview"). Also GIF, PSD, MPO, AVIF.
• Videos (MP4 / MOV / M4V) are in your folders now, with a frame as their thumbnail.
• In the viewer GIFs play and videos loop their first 2 seconds (silent). Alt+Q (or right-click): the whole video with sound / pause / play.
• ⚙ menu → Play GIFs & videos: off = they stay still.
